svg.title: 03 | Angle configuration space / 公转-自转角度空间

g.text: 03 | Angle configuration space / 公转-自转角度空间
Same color scale in both modes: pink = smaller centerline gap; dark teal = larger gap. Black/white: current path.
Delta-psi endpoints 0 and 120 are geometrically periodic, but different unwrapped motor positions. No free phase jumps.
